page.layout: Running head and page number at the top; one column of running text in the centre; notes in the left margin (Cafus 4o; Gothifr. ad l.3.C.d; si minor, sc major.); centred heading "SECT. XII." above the second paragraph; catchword "pe" at the lower right. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of lines.

main_text.p: Juramenti, in quo præter verba prolata adhibetur etiam aliquis externus visibilis motus corporalis; ut tactus altarium,femoris, aut libri, projectio lapidis, levatio manus, & similia, dici solet Juramentum Corporale, Balsamoni [illegible, ~5 letters] [illegible, ~7 letters].
main_text.head: SECT. XII.
main_text.p: Cafus 4oDe his ritibus qui in solennibus Juramentis solent adhiberi, Cafus fecundus sive Quæstio secunda est, An & quatenus addant vim aliquam obligationi Juri-jurandi; Quod est quærere, An Juramentum folenne & corporale fortius obliget simplici: ita ut gravius sit perjurium violati solennis Juramenti quam simplicis? Pro responsione dico primo, à Cafuistis non modo Pontificiæ[?] partis sed & Ecclesiarum Reformatarum concedi, Solennitatem actus aggravare peccatum in Juramento, perinde ac in Voto: quum sit Juramenti & Voto in plerisque, maxime in virtute obligandi[?] Gothifr. ad l.3.C.dconfimilis ratio. {a}Jurare corporaliter plus est quam instrumento aut nuda voc[?] inquit ex illis quidam: & alius, {b}Quan[?] si minor, sc major.plus crescunt folennitates, tanto majus e[?]

page.notes: Right ends of lines are cut off by the scan edge; words there are read only as far as visible and marked [?]. The Greek after "Balsamoni" is not legible enough to read and is marked as illegible. "fi"/"fc" in the margin are read as "si"/"sc". The reference "b" appears twice (margin notes "b Gothifr." and "b fi minor"; text "alius, b Quan"); the second margin note has no own letter. The word "visibilis" is split at the line end and its ending is hidden by the edge. The last line is cut off; "pe" below it is treated as the catchword.
